title: Fresh Prescription Reduction on Late Northgate Optical Remakes: Training Questions
content:
**What is the fresh-prescription reduction?** A reduction of the late prescription-change remake charge on a Northgate Optical job whose prescription was recent when the job was ordered. Where the job's prescription was issued no more than 3 whole months before the job was ordered, the fresh-prescription reduction is 10 percent, and where it was issued 4 to 9 whole months before the job was ordered, it is 5 percent.

**Which dates are compared?** The prescription issue date and the order date, both as shown on the eyewear job. The age is counted in whole months from the issue date to the order date.

**What if the prescription was older than 9 whole months when the job was ordered?** Then there is no fresh-prescription reduction.

**Does the date of the prescription-change remake matter here?** No. Only the prescription's age on the job's order date is read.

## Reduction by prescription age at ordering

| Whole months from issue date to order date | Fresh-prescription reduction |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 10 percent |
| 4 to 9 | 5 percent |
| 10 or more | none |

## Practice questions (hypothetical jobs)

1. *A job was ordered 3 whole months after its prescription was issued.* 10 percent.
2. *A job was ordered 4 whole months after the issue date.* 5 percent.
3. *A job was ordered 9 whole months after the issue date.* 5 percent.
4. *A job was ordered 10 whole months after the issue date.* No reduction.
